params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
$wt=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'agent-worktrees\workflow-deterministic-salvage-20260929'
$branch='integration/workflow-deterministic-salvage-20260929'
git -C $repo fetch origin --prune
git -C $repo worktree prune
if(Test-Path $wt){ git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null; if(Test-Path $wt){ Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $wt } }
git -C $repo show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$branch"
if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){ git -C $repo branch -D $branch | Out-Null }
git -C $repo worktree add -b $branch $wt origin/main
Push-Location $wt
try {
  $base=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
  git cherry-pick --no-commit 02fa1dd5c3e98d319067043598bfdfd32617e65f
  $cp=$LASTEXITCODE

  $ours=@(
    '.verification/function-status.json',
    'CHANGELOG.md',
    'README.md',
    '_AGENT_CONTEXT/CURRENT_STATE.md',
    '_AGENT_CONTEXT/NEXT_STEPS.md',
    '_AGENT_CONTEXT/README_FIRST.md',
    '_AGENT_CONTEXT/VERIFICATION.md',
    '_AGENT_CONTEXT/handoff-manifest.json',
    'src/MhwModManager.App/MainWindow.xaml',
    'src/MhwModManager.App/ViewModels/MainWindowViewModel.cs',
    'src/MhwModManager.Automation/CrashBisectorEngine.cs',
    'src/MhwModManager.Automation/SmartInboxService.cs',
    'tools/MhwModManager.SelfTest/Program.cs'
  )
  foreach($p in $ours){
    if(Test-Path $p){ git checkout HEAD -- $p }
  }

  $drop=@(
    '.github/workflows/windows-workflows.yml',
    '_AGENT_CONTEXT/EVIDENCE/workflow-expansion-function-scan.json',
    '_AGENT_CONTEXT/EVIDENCE/workflow-expansion-validation.log',
    '_AGENT_CONTEXT/WORKFLOW_IMPLEMENTATION.md'
  )
  foreach($p in $drop){
    if(Test-Path $p){ git rm -f --ignore-unmatch -- $p | Out-Null }
  }

  git add -A
  $unmerged=@(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)
  if($unmerged.Count -gt 0){ throw ('UNRESOLVED_CONFLICTS: '+($unmerged -join ',')) }

  $diffcheckOut=& git diff --cached --check 2>&1
  $diffcheck=$LASTEXITCODE

  $buildLog=Join-Path $wt 'BuildLogs\workflow-deterministic-build.log'
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $buildLog -Parent)|Out-Null
  & dotnet build MhwModManager.sln -c Release -m:1 -warnaserror *> $buildLog
  $build=$LASTEXITCODE
  $tail=@(Get-Content $buildLog -Tail 240 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)

  [pscustomobject]@{
    base=$base
    cherry_pick_exit=$cp
    diff_check_exit=$diffcheck
    build_exit=$build
    staged=@(git diff --cached --name-status)
    status=@(git status --short)
    build_tail=$tail
  } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
} finally { Pop-Location }
